message: The other night, we had a surprise blackout right in the middle of dinner prep! My partner was a bit skeptical when I insisted we should have a couple of power banks charged up and a flashlight handy. But as we fumbled around in the dark, I couldn't help but feel a little smug when I pulled out my trusty lantern and a fully charged phone. It turned what could have been a frustrating evening into a cozy candlelit dinner (minus the candles, of course!). It’s those little moments of being prepared that make all the difference. What’s your go-to tip for staying comfy during an outage?
